methodologyNotes: Covers built-in electric and gas wall ovens installed in a cabinet cutout, sold at a published US price. Excludes freestanding and slide-in ranges, countertop toaster ovens, and standalone built-in microwaves. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. configuration is single, double, or combination (an oven paired with a built-in microwave). widthInches is the nominal cabinet cutout width in inches (typically 24, 27, or 30). fuelType is electric, gas, or dual-fuel. capacityCuFt is total usable oven cavity volume in cubic feet (combined across both cavities for double and combination units). convectionType is none, fan-convection (fan only), or true-convection (fan plus a dedicated third heating element). numRacks is the count of included oven racks. maxBakeTempF is the highest selectable bake temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (excludes the higher self-clean cycle). selfCleanType is none, pyrolytic (high-heat), steam, or pyrolytic-and-steam. airFryMode is true if a built-in air-fry cooking mode is provided. meatProbe is true if an integrated temperature probe is included. smartWifi is true if the oven has built-in Wi-Fi and app connectivity.
